author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for The Lonely Miner, a 2D pixel art style, incremental clicker game developed by DuckDevStudios. You are dropped onto an Island with a pickaxe and a dream. A dream to hit rocks and gain money. Collect rocks, sell rocks, hire workers, and get rich! The Lonely Miner will be available soon on PC, with a demo available now on Steam.
title: The Lonely Miner - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Climbing Simplified, a minimalist physics-based climbing puzzle game developed by ChrisHenry. Every move matters. Players will scale indoor gyms, granite faces, sandstone cliffs, deep-water solo lines, bouldering routes, and more. Master a mix of different climbing holds each with their own unique challenge. Adapt to lightning, wind, and rain that change how climbs feel and play. Climbing Simplified will be available on PC in 2026.
title: Climbing Simplified - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Monslice announcement trailer for this upcoming short incremental game about slicing monsters, collecting resources, expanding your skill tree, unlocking and buying more monsters! Monslice will be available on PC.
title: Monslice - Official Announcement Trailer
